participation.context: Gave Alse the three gingerbread men, and went up.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said fairings rot the teeth, and saw the stair-post.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Took them, and kept the gilt one for the shelf.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You gave Alse the gingerbread from Smithfield. Mistress Ansell said fairings rot the teeth, and sent you up.
topics: the back from the fourth hour

title: Gave the three gingerbread men to Alse
